Elena — thanks for the note and sorry for the confusion. I pulled the raw lead export from our onsite form and the CRM tieout. Attached: Skybound_raw_leads_export_0103.csv (attachment).

Quick context on methodology we used:
- We map form captures -> HubSpot contact via email exact match.
- If form lacked email, we used badge-scans + manual rep notes and only counted if rep validated contact info within 48 hours.
- Demo requests were routed to a separate pipeline; in the initial reconciliation we only included leads that met "sales-contacted" criteria by 1/1 to avoid counting duplicates.

I'm sending Ben the export and asking for a CRM tieout pass to make sure nothing fell through. Will follow up with a reconciled sheet by early next week.

Cheers,

Preliminary findings: 11 unique HubSpot contacts linked to the event record, 2 of which were duplicates we merged, leaving 9 active contacts in the event pipeline. The 14 Elena referenced likely includes 3 that were recorded as "badge only" (no email) and 2 follow-ups that were logged to reps but not pushed into the event pipeline because they were marked as "partner referral".

Action items I propose:
1) Share the merged/unmerged ID list (I attached a small extract).
2) Agree on a reconciliation rule for badge-only leads (do we give sponsor partial credit or require email/consent?).
3) If Skybound wants commercial credit for badge-only leads, we can offer a 50% credit in this instance pending consent collection.

Thanks Ben — that helps. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- The 3 "badge-only" contacts were collected at the sponsor kiosk where attendees opted into follow-up and wrote an email on a paper form; our events team uploaded those directly into our CRM on 12/29 with consent flags. We can share our upload if that helps match records.

Elena — thanks for the details and the offer to share your upload. I pulled together a reconciled workbook and a proposed credit plan (attached: reconciled_pipeline_snapshot_0107.xlsx and redwood-skybound-mutual_action_plan_0107.pdf). Summary below:

Reconciliation highlights:
- Total Skybound-attributable rows after matching: 14 (9 email-matched + 3 badge-uploaded matched by email + 2 rep-notes marked Skybound origin).
- Of those 14, 4 have moved to MQL/demo stage and 1 into closed-won (small pilot, $12k ARR).
- My earlier report excluded the badge-uploaded rows because we didn't receive the photo of the paper form/consent at the time of the initial import.

Proposed resolution and compensation:
- Accept Skybound-uploaded leads as valid when the upload includes attendee email and consent flag. We have validated the uploads you sent and matched 3 badge-only rows.
- We will apply full sponsorship credit for the 14 reconciled leads for pipeline reporting this quarter.
- For billing reconciliation: offer a one-time sponsor rebate equal to 10% of the sponsorship fee (to be applied against the Dec invoice) to account for the initial mismatch in reported counts and the extra reconciliation effort. Naomi, can you confirm whether finance can approve a 10% sponsor rebate and the accounting entry?

Next steps:
- Ben to merge final IDs into the event record (by 1/9).
- Elena to confirm receipt of reconciled file and approve the proposed rebate.
- Naomi to confirm finance approval for rebate and billing adjustment.

Thanks — feel free to call if anyone wants to walk through the workbook live.

Marissa Cole
